title: GitHub polling cron job — fetch new commits and releases every 60 minutes
description: Set up a recurring cron job that polls GitHub for new commits and releases for all connected projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetches all projects with github_repo_name set and non-null github_access_token
For each project, calls importCommitsForProject with commits since the last known commit
Errors for individual projects are logged but do not stop other projects from syncing
Job runs on server startup and on schedule

steps.details: Create server/src/jobs/githubSync.ts. Export function startGithubSyncJob(). Use cron.schedule('0 * * * *', async () => { ... }) for hourly. Inside: query projects WHERE github_repo_name IS NOT NULL. For each, get the user's encrypted token, decrypt, create Octokit, call importCommitsForProject(projectId, octokit, owner, repo) wrapped in try/catch.
In server/src/index.ts, import and call startGithubSyncJob() after the DB connection is confirmed.
Temporarily change schedule to '* * * * *' (every minute) for testing. Connect a repo and wait. Verify new commits appear after the minute fires. Restore to hourly schedule.
